commentary: Sweden's macroeconomic baseline is stable entering the September 2026 election. GDP growth 0.82% (2024), unemployment 8.69% (2025), inflation 2.84% (2024). The HD01FiU48 fuel tax relief (82 öre/litre May–September 2026) provides household relief. The government's fiscal narrative is supported by HD03100 spring economic bill. Opposition risk: healthcare spending gaps highlighted by 77 committee reservations.
